args.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for telling us. A gassy smell needs treating as an emergency, so please do this now: do not use the oven or hob, any switches or flames. Open doors and windows, and leave the flat with everyone in it. Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (999 if anyone feels unwell). Is a carbon monoxide alarm sounding, and does anyone have a headache, dizziness, nausea or drowsiness? Please reply to confirm everyone is out. We are sending a Gas Safe engineer to make the appliance safe; our target is within 24 hours, and we will confirm the time once set. Please don't use the oven until it has been checked.
